title: Summary update from an emitted symbol
statement: Given an existing optional Boolean summary and an optional emitted Boolean symbol, retain the existing summary if no symbol is emitted. If a symbol is emitted, the result is true exactly when the prior summary is absent and the emitted symbol is true; in all other emission cases the result is false.
